ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 ns tem http://tempuri.org/ output application/xml skipNullOn = "everywhere", writeDeclaredNamespaces = "All" --- { tem#AsignarCUN: { tem#TipoPQR: payload.pqrType, tem#FechaPQR: payload.pqrDate, tem#Sistema: payload.system, tem#NumOrden: payload.orderNumber, tem#TipoIdentificacion: payload.identificationType, tem#Identificacion: payload.identification, tem#NumConexion: payload.connectionNumber, tem#Usuario: p('secure::cun.soap.user'), tem#Contrasena: p('secure::cun.soap.pass') } }
